artworks.title: The Marshes of Burbanche (Marais de la Burbanche)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded landscape by a calm river or stream. The horizon is at the bottom third of the composition, with tree reflections on the water. Trees and a dome-like structure are seen in the distance. Detailed etching depicts a dense forest and sky patterns. The color palette is monochromatic using shades of black and white for contrast and texture.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.medium: pen and ink with oil over chalk on four sheets of paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund and The Ahmanson Foundation
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring numerous figures on both earth and in the sky. The earthly landscape shows human activity and various expressions. The sky is filled with celestial and angelic forms swirling around a central bright figure against a luminous sky. The painting has rich detail and contrasts between earthly and divine figures. It follows the style of Giorgio Vasari, exhibiting Mannerist aesthetics of elongated figures and dynamic compositions.

artworks.title: Design for "The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1774: Hercules and the Dragon in the Garden of the Hesperides"
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural facade. The drawing depicts a large, ornate building with classical architectural features such as columns, pediments, and balustrades. The central section of the building is elevated, with a large archway and a grand staircase leading up to it. Sculptures adorn the top of the structure and the stairs. Below, there are various figures and a majestic fountain with sculptural elements. The drawing is rendered in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Construction of the 1862 International Exhibition at South Kensington
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a construction site featuring scaffolding and ladders in front of buildings. The image captures a scene at a construction site with a focus on a tall wooden structure supporting a decorative column piece with intricate spiral designs and ornate carvings. Ladders are positioned against the structure, and various wooden beams are arranged around the site. In the background, a row of large, multi-story buildings provides an urban backdrop with uniform windows and architectural details typical of period cityscapes.

artworks.title: Gefængnis für die Schaubühne (Scenographic Design for a Prison)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased in Memory of Marianne S. Schwartz
artworks.description: The image features a vaulted corridor with an arched ceiling. A distant archway frames a lit circular emblem, adding depth to the composition. The architecture is detailed with etching, creating textured stonework. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white. Stone arches and walls draw the eye inward, while smaller figures and highlights suggest scale and depth within the space.

artworks.title: Gefængnis für die Schaubühne (Scenographic Design for a Prison)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased in Memory of Marianne S. Schwartz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient architectural ruin with a gate. The image features a view through a series of archways in a stone structure, leading to an iron-barred gate at the forefront. The setting includes heavy, rugged stones and rustic textures of masonry. Large columns can be seen in the background. The archways show a play of light and shadow, enhancing depth and mood. Adjacent to the archway is a wooden staircase. The drawing is detailed, capturing textures and forms of the stone precisely.

artworks.title: François Langlois
artworks.artist: Jean Pesne, after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof before title]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a detailed black and white drawing of the upper body of a man. He is positioned with his body turned slightly to the left, while his face is angled slightly to the right, looking towards the viewer. The man has a full, curly beard and curly hair peeking from under a wide-brimmed hat. His facial expression is neutral and relaxed. He is dressed in a loose, folded garment with visible textures, resembling a flowing cloak or robe, and a lighter undergarment, likely a shirt. On his right arm, he has a decorative fabric or embroidery with a detailed design. In his hands, he holds bagpipes with the instrument's pipes and airbag clearly visible. His left hand is holding another part of the instrument. The background comprises a subtly textured or shaded surface, possibly indicating depth behind him, with the snout of an animal, likely a dog, peeking from the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Imaginary Landscape with an Amorous Couple
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with two reclining figures, a curved path, a dog, and a tree in the foreground. In the background, there is an architectural scene with domed and towered structures, cityscape, and a mountainous landscape. The sky has stylized cloud formations. The artwork utilizes a color palette of black and neutral tones, with intricate etched lines defining each element.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Baptism of Christ
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Lucas Gassel
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed landscape with a low horizon, featuring a distant town with multiple buildings and a castle on a hill. The scene includes a bridge over a stream, figures walking, trees, rustic buildings, and people engaged in various activities under trees. The sky has swirling clouds and a central divine figure. The artwork shows intricate engravings with careful craftsmanship in a monochrome color palette of black, white, and gray.

artworks.title: The Child Jesus
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a young child's body facing forward with their head slightly tilted to the side. The child has large eyes and a small smile, long wavy hair, and is wearing a draped garment. In the background, there are concentric oval lines radiating outward from the child's head creating a halo-like effect.

artworks.title: African Woman
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint printed in brown and black with scraping, heightened with white gouache, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a profile view of a person's head and upper shoulders. The individual faces left with only the side of their face visible. They have distinct facial features and wear a striped headscarf tied at the back. The person wears a garment with a collar, and appears to have a knotted tie at the neck. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Michelangelo Buonarroti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on buff Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased in Memory of Lionel C. Epstein
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man seated in a three-quarter view, facing towards the right. The man has a lined face with a sharp facial structure, a full beard, and short, curly hair. He is wearing a dark robe, with only his left hand resting on a surface visible. The background is a textured surface resembling a wall, with the name "MICHEL ANGELO BVONARRVOTTI" inscribed along the top. The image is monochromatic with varying shades of black and tan.

artworks.title: Moses Striking Water from the Rock
artworks.artist: Giulio Bonasone, after Polidoro da Caravaggio (formerly after Parmigianino)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a group of figures gathered around a central event in a communal or public space. Various figures, including adults and children, are depicted engaged in the scene. Two figures on the right are shown performing an action with a vessel or container. They are dressed in classical robes, and their postures convey anticipation and activity. Wooden structures resembling buildings are present in the background, along with hills or vegetation. The illustration exhibits detailed textures in the robes and architecture, resembling the style of Parmigianino.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.artist: Jean Morin, after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a nativity scene featuring multiple figures and animals. Several adults and a child are shown around a crib with a baby. To the left, a group of people in robes is present, with one figure in front raising a hand. Two angels fly above with a banner. A woman near the crib wears a headscarf and looks at the baby while a man on the right holds a stick. Animals in the scene include a dog, a cow, and a lamb. The setting is a wooden stable with plants and a visible beam. The scene is detailed with wood grain and foliage.

artworks.title: Soir d'hiver à Montmartre (Winter Evening in Montmartre)
artworks.medium: aquatint and soft-ground etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased in Memory of Marianne S. Schwartz
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view with buildings, a windmill, and a cobblestone path leading into the distance. The sky has warm, muted tones indicating early evening or twilight. Streetlamps illuminate the scene, and the overall color palette includes earthy browns, soft oranges, and pale pinks. The style appears to be a print with fine brushstrokes or etching lines, creating a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Memorial Sheet for the Artist's Brother, Johann Heinrich Rode
artworks.medium: etching and lavis on paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a profile portrait of an individual. The person is positioned side-on, facing left, with their facial profile visible. They have a prominent nose, high forehead, and thin lips. Their hair is sparse and slightly receding. The individual wears a simple garment, possibly a loose-fitting shirt or robe. Below the portrait, there are objects placed, including a small basin or a similar object, and slender tools or instruments with handles. The background is dark with a rounded border surrounding the head to emphasize the person's features.

artworks.title: Peter Johansen Nytti
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: There are two black and white photographs of the same person from the waist up. In the left photo, the individual is seated in a side profile facing left, wearing a textured garment and cap with a small pom-pom. The right photo shows the person facing the camera directly, with hands clasped in their lap. The background is simple. The card is labeled "LAPONS" and "PETER JOHANSEN NYTTI."

artworks.title: Ellen Berrit Gretesdatter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: There are two black and white portrait photographs on display. Both photos feature the upper half of a woman's body. In the left photo, she is in profile looking to the right, while in the right photo, she is facing forward. The woman has a solemn expression with sharp facial features and hair under a plaid headscarf. She wears a dark garment and holds an infant wrapped in a light cloth. There is no visible jewelry, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Niels Johansen Ommar
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows two black and white photographs of the same person, displaying different angles. Both photographs depict the upper body of Niels Johansen Ommar, who is seated and slightly leaning forward. In the left photograph, the person faces the camera directly, while in the right photograph, they are shown in profile, looking to the right. The individual's facial features appear strong and defined, with a high forehead, straight nose, and solemn expression. Their hair is dark and slightly unkempt, and they wear a textured hat that matches their clothing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Wellfleet, Cape Cod
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a blue-toned photograph that shows a grassy landscape with a path on the left that curves past a hill on the right with a small wooden house on top of it. In front of the house is a tree with some foliage and some bare branches. The path appears sandy, with faint tracks visible in it.  The sky above is clear.

artworks.title: Alexander Gardner, William Henry Jackson, and Antonio Zeno Shindler with Pueblo delegates Alejandro Padilla, Governor of Isleta, and Ambrosio Abeita, Ex-Governor of Isleta
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five men posing for a portrait. The front row contains three seated men, while the back row has two standing men with their hands on the shoulders of those seated. The seated men have long hair, dark coats, tribal blankets, and hats. The standing men have facial hair, one with a beard and the other with short hair. They wear suits and bow ties. The backdrop is plain and light-colored.

artworks.title: Solitude
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a forest scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The landscape is dominated by dense foliage and towering trees, creating a canopy. The brushstrokes capture textures of leaves, tree trunks, and rocky formations with detail. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and sepia. In the foreground, there are rocky surfaces and plant life, leading to a receding forest and a vague opening or path into the depths of the woods. The background is a thickening growth that blurs into lighter tones.

artworks.title: Impronte, Pompei (Cast, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a human figure in a contorted position, with knees bent and arms wrapped around the legs. The material appears to be a light-colored plaster or stone with a rough texture. The sculpture is positioned on a dark surface, offering a stark contrast. The figure is seen from the side, showing exaggerated curves and shapes of the limbs, which twist and fold into each other in a compact manner.

artworks.title: Impronte Umane, Pompei (Human Casts, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts two human figures lying on their sides. They appear to be in relaxed poses, with one figure slightly higher than the other. The figures are made of a material resembling plaster or cast, giving them a rough, textured surface. The color of the sculptures is a pale, faded white, contrasting against the dark background they rest upon. The figures are life-sized and their features are recognizable as human, but with some erosion or damage blurring finer details. The figures are positioned next to each other in a manner suggestive of repose or sleep.
